successCriteria.description: `npm run build` completes cleanly with no TypeScript errors after the factory rewiring.
`src/modules/balance/balance.service.ts` no longer contains any import from `../leave-type` (the `import { LeaveTypeService, PgLeaveTypeRepository } from '../leave-type';` line is removed).

`createBalanceService()` constructs its `IPolicyService` dependency by calling `createPolicyService()` imported from `../policy`, not by inlining `new PolicyService(new PgLeavePolicyRepository(), new LeaveTypeService(new PgLeaveTypeRepository()))`.
The `../policy` import block in `balance.service.ts` retains only `IPolicyService`, `LeavePolicy`, and `LeavePolicyStatus`; `PolicyService` and `PgLeavePolicyRepository` are removed.
All existing tests pass unchanged (no test file is modified and no test assertion changes).

constraints: The `BalanceService` class, its constructor signature, and all runtime behaviour are unchanged — only the `createBalanceService()` factory body and the import statements change.
`createPolicyService` must be imported from the policy module's public entry point (`../policy`), never from a deep file path such as `../policy/policy.service`.
`src/modules/balance/index.ts` is not modified — its existing re-export of `createBalanceService` is unaffected.
No file outside `src/modules/balance/balance.service.ts` is modified in this phase (the policy factory from Phase 1 and the leave module's factory are out of scope).
outOfScope: Rewiring `createLeaveService()` in `src/modules/leave/leave.service.ts` to call `createPolicyService()` and removing the `leave -> leave-type` import (Phase 3).
Any change to the `PolicyService` class, `createPolicyService()`, or the policy module's public entry point (delivered in Phase 1).
Any change to the `BalanceService` class, its constructor signature, its methods, or its runtime behaviour.
Adding, removing, or modifying tests, routes, controllers, or any other module.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: `createBalanceService()` must delegate to the exact `createPolicyService()` factory exported from the policy public entry point, which constructs `new PolicyService(new PgLeavePolicyRepository(), new LeaveTypeService(new PgLeaveTypeRepository()))` — the same collaborators the balance factory previously inlined, so the constructed `IPolicyService` is behaviourally identical.

The retained `../policy` imports (`IPolicyService`, `LeavePolicy`, `LeavePolicyStatus`) must resolve to the same symbols the class already uses, so the `BalanceService` constructor parameter type and the `getCurrentBalances` policy-selection logic are unchanged.
The resulting dependency direction must match the documented map: `balance -> policy` and `policy -> leave-type`, with no `balance -> leave-type` edge.

integrationPoints.why: The balance factory now obtains its `IPolicyService` dependency from the policy module's composition factory instead of constructing it inline.
